milestones.title: Outside: a real street
milestones.summary: Replace the painted backdrop with a 3D neighbourhood street seen from a third-floor window: a Blender-built street, its own sky and haze, lit on its own layer so parallax sells the space.

items.text: Street pipeline: art/models/street (Blender) to godot/art/street/street.glb
Blockout: our facade, sidewalks, curbs, road with parking lanes, a cross street, the far row of buildings, rooftops behind, a distant skyline
Sky dome per mood (gradient, stars, moon, sun, clouds) and distance haze
In game: street on its own render layer with its own sun/moon and ambient; painted view retired
Shots from several angles, including the fish's view through the tank
Fixes along the way: closed the room's wall corners, sharp-edged boxes in every model (false light in the corner), the stand's z-fighting door panels

milestones.title: Outside: buildings
milestones.summary: Facades that read as a real neighbourhood: brick rowhouses and a corner shop, with rooms behind the windows.

items.text: Facade kit: brick, stucco and clapboard, cornices with brackets and dentils, flat, hooded and arched lintels, stoops, bay windows, fire escapes
Window rooms: interior-mapped rooms behind the glass, lit by mood, with curtains, blinds and sheers, TVs, and cats and plants on the sills; sky reflections
Ground floor shops: awnings, painted signs, neon in the windows, a RAMEN blade sign, shelves and counters inside, a laundromat with washers
Rooftops: water towers, chimneys, bulkheads, AC units, vents, parapets
A faded TORTELLINI'S ghost sign on a bare party wall
Railings, fences and fire-escape gratings as cut-out panels (see-through, and far fewer triangles)
Cars rebuilt: lofted bodies with glass, pillars, wheels in wells, mirrors and lights; taxis

milestones.title: Outside: street life
milestones.summary: The things that fill a street: trees, lamps, parked cars, wires, clutter, and traffic that passes by.

items.text: Street trees with leaf sprays that shade as round crowns; the one by our window low enough to look over
Street lamps, traffic signals that take turns, street signs, hydrants, bins, a mailbox, bike racks, café tables and an A-frame
Parked cars; cars that drive past, stop at red and light the road ahead at night
Telephone poles and wires, with drops across the street to our building
People walking the sidewalks, dressed at random, with umbrellas in the rain (far sidewalk widened to fit them)
A flock of pigeons now and then at golden hour

milestones.title: Outside: moods
milestones.summary: Each mood lights the street its own way.

items.text: Night: lamp pools on the pavement and facades, lit windows and shops, neon, stars, a low moon
Rainy evening: falling rain in sheets at several depths, wet road and puddles that ring with drops and reflect the lights, heavier haze, umbrellas
Golden hour: a warm sky and haze that keep their colour, the low sun behind the far row casting long shadows toward us
Room: sunlit window reveals no longer glow like a lightbox (bright bake eased off above white)
Quality: street sun shadows from Medium, shop, neon and headlight lights from Medium, half the people on Low; about 2 ms a frame on High

milestones.title: Rain on the glass
milestones.summary: Drops that run down, not up, and behave like water.

items.text: Fix: running drops move downward (the pattern scrolled the wrong way for the pane's UVs)
Beads are tiny lenses: each shows the street behind it shrunken and upside down, with a dark rim and a glint
Beads come and go; runners stall and lurch, wander a little, wipe the beads in their way and leave a wet, beaded trail that dries
Fine mist over the glass; drop sizes in real millimetres, fading out below a pixel instead of sparkling
--frames and --frame-step for screenshot sequences

milestones.title: Fish polish
milestones.summary: A friendlier face and a more natural swim.

items.text: Mouth: a blunt, rounded snout with an upper and a fuller lower lip over a dark mouth, instead of the puckered point; the lower lip drops now and then in a gulp
Eyes: crisp gold irises, a darker rim and round pupils as their own caps (painted vertices left them jagged)
Body: a fantail's egg that stays full and pinches into the peduncle rather than a cone; procedural scales
Swimming: the spine bends and cross-sections turn with it (no shearing); the fin flutter weights were upside down (glTF flips v), so the whole body pulsed; fixed
--fish-pose to hold the fish swimming in place for screenshots; frame strips of the swim and a gulp

milestones.title: Polish pass
milestones.summary: Look at everything together, from every angle and mood; performance on each quality level.

items.text: Review pass across moods and cameras: room, fish, room camera, tank cam, street level
Performance: about 2 ms a frame on High and 1.1 ms on Low at 1600x900 (discrete GPU)
Retired the painted views and the backdrop in the room build (lightmap UVs verified unchanged, bakes kept)
Guide updated for the street; tracker shots.json covers the street, the rain and the fish

milestones.title: Look like Tortellini
milestones.summary: Model the fish on the real Tortellini (art/reference/tortellini.jpg): a longer fantail with a red cap, silvery cheeks and belly, small realistic eyes and long, flowing, translucent fins.

items.text: Body: longer and deeper than the cartoon egg, a gently humped back, a slightly bumpy red head cap
Colour: red-orange head, deep orange body, silvery-white cheeks, gill cover and belly patch, a few pale scales
Eyes: small, gold-ringed and realistic
Fins: tall sail dorsal; a long double tail with pointed lobes that droop and flow; long trailing pelvic and anal fins; translucent orange fading paler at the edges
Swimming tuned for the longer fins (they trail and drape more); side-by-side with the photo
